info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Fitness Memberships Guestpass-v2-spec
info.description: The Guest Pass Memberships API provides access to information about available fitness memberships that include guest pass options. This endpoint allows users to retrieve details on different membership plans, including their benefits and limitations regarding guest visits. Typically utilized by fitness centers and potential members, the API supports use cases such as exploring membership options, facilitating guest access, and enhancing customer engagement in fitness services. This resource is essential for organizations aiming to boost client participation and optimize membership offerings.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve information about guest pass memberships available. It provides details on the terms, conditions, and usage of guest passes for users.
